title: プロジェクトデザイン特別科目（ＡＩ活用実践）（春期集中講義）
subtitle: Special Subject - Design Project(AI Application and Implementation)
courseType: （Provided by all courses）Liberal Arts CoursesTransdisciplinary Learning
educationalGoal: In this class, students will prototype and verify systems that use AI technology to solve problems on campus. During prototyping and verification, students will utilize generative AI and learn about the system development process. Students will understand AI technology and how to apply generative AI. Students will also improve their skills in effective communication of information through project planning, progress management, and documentation.
advice:
In this class, students will verify the effectiveness of AI technology by creating a prototype of a system to solve a problem on campus for the purpose of problem solving through PBL. In addition, students will acquire skills in the system development process (design → development → verification), as well as document creation and system development using AI.

Main contents of the class
1. Acquisition of skills for each process in system development
Learn what needs to be considered in each process (basic design, system design, functional design, etc.) and create the necessary documents by using the generated AI.
2. Prototyping a system that embodies the solution
Prototype a system that embodies the solution using AI based on the created documents.
3. Verify the effectiveness of the developed system
Evaluate the performance of the system and verify its effectiveness in solving the problem.
4. Presentation
Demonstration and presentation of the prototype system will be conducted as a summary of the class.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and experience learned and acquired by the time of the course.

activityGoals.body: To be able to apply the knowledge acquired in university studies to problem solving
To be able to search, research, and understand anything that is unclear
To be able to use AI to solve problems
To be able to proceed smoothly with system development
To be able to communicate results to third parties in a logical and easy-to-understand manner
To be able to demonstrate a willingness to objectively evaluate one's own abilities
